name: net_is_opt_entry_active_in_any_slot
description: Net::IsOptEntryActiveInAnySlot scans the local player alt-weapon banks and returns whether the supplied OptCatalog entry is assigned to an enabled controller slot.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; BN reconstruction is limited by the loop cursor artifact, and final byte matching should be handled with the coherent Pickup/GameNet source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41de30 validates fastcall ECX=optEntry, scanning ten PlayerAltWeaponBank entries from g_GameStateOrMapTable->playerState, checking controllerA/controllerB optCatalogEntry pointer equality and flag bit 4 before returning 1, otherwise returning 0.

The native smoke verifies empty banks, matching disabled controller rejection, matching enabled controllerA acceptance, nonmatching enabled controller rejection, and matching enabled controllerB acceptance.
